Eurovision Games — frequently asked questions

Quick answers to the questions hosts and players ask most. The three most-asked — creating, joining, and leaving — are highlighted at the top. The rest are in an accordion below. For deeper detail see the rule book, scoring formulas, and setup guide.

The three most asked

  1. 1Creating a roomClick "Create a Room", enter your name, pick an avatar and set a room password — no sign-up or email needed.
  2. 2Joining a roomUse the join link the host shared (one tap, no account), or open Eurovision Games, click "Join a Room", and type the 6-character code plus your display name.
  3. 3Leaving or deleting a roomTap your name in the room header → "Leave room".

Getting started

19

Click "Create a Room", enter your name, pick an avatar and set a room password — no sign-up or email needed. A 6-character room code and shareable link appear instantly; rooms hold up to 20 players. The host owns the room until they leave or delete it.

Defaults that work

  • 3 quiz rounds — enough warm-up without dragging.
  • Max 20 players — the upper limit; smaller rooms feel snappier.
  • One challenge each way per pair, plus one rematch — prevents one-target grinding.

Use the join link the host shared (one tap, no account), or open Eurovision Games, click "Join a Room", and type the 6-character code plus your display name. Late joiners can still make predictions, play quiz and duel until voting opens, when everything locks automatically.

  • Easiest path: tap the join link the host shared. One step, no account.
  • Manual: open Eurovision Games → Join a Room → enter the 6-character code plus a display name.
  • Late joiners can still make predictions, play trivia and duel — everything locks automatically when voting opens.

Tap your name in the room header → "Leave room". Your slot frees up; your scored points stay frozen on the leaderboard so the rest of the room is unaffected. Hosts can also delete the room from "Your Rooms" on the home page, which ends the session for everyone — a confirmation prompt prevents accidents.

  • Players tap their name in the room header → Leave room. Banked points stay frozen on the leaderboard.
  • Hosts can also delete the room from Your Rooms on the home page — a confirmation prompt prevents accidents.
  • Accidental leave? Re-join with the same code and display name any time before the room reaches Final Results. Your points are restored.
